description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Grazing Kelpie.
When Grazing Kelpie dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
When Grazing Kelpie enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
